wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-permission: Error message shown over the REST API when the user lacks permission to change the review status of a revision.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-not-flagge: Error message shown over the REST API when recording a review verdict on a revision that is not marked with an abuse review tag.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-conflictin: Error message shown over the REST API when recording a review verdict on a revision that already has a different verdict. A revision holds one verdict at a time.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-not: Error message shown over the REST API when trying to unmark a revision that is not currently marked as a false positive.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-disabled: Error message shown over the REST API when abuse review is disabled by configuration on this wiki.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-unknown-ta:
Error message shown over the REST API when the requested tag is not a reviewable tag.

Parameters:
* $1 - the requested tag name.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-blocked: Error message shown over the REST API when a blocked user tries to change the review status of a revision.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-mark-descr: Description of what the endpoint that records a review verdict does, shown to API consumers in the generated API documentation.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-unmark-des: Description of what the endpoint that removes a review verdict does, shown to API consumers in the generated API documentation.
